content_sections.heading: RITES Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for RITES Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification and professional experience requirements mentioned for each position. The recruitment is specifically designed for experienced Civil Engineering professionals having expertise in bridge design, modelling and analysis of RCC and PSC long span bridge structures.

content_sections.heading: RITES Individual Consultant Educational Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: The educational qualification requirement for all three positions is B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering.

rows.post_name: Sr. Bridge Design Specialist for Viaduct and other structures

content_sections.heading: RITES Consultant Experience Requirement 2026
content_sections.text: Total Experience Required: 6 Years Minimum 4 years of specific experience in modelling, analysis and design of superstructure of RCC and PSC long span bridges. Experience with MIDAS and/or Sofistik is required. Experience area includes major river bridges, ROBs, flyovers and underpasses related to highway projects. Total Experience Required: 7 Years Minimum 5 years of specific experience in modelling, analysis and design of superstructure and substructure of RCC and PSC long span bridges. Knowledge of STAAD, MIDAS and/or Sofistik is required. Experience area includes river bridges, grade separators, flyovers and underpasses related to highway projects. Total Experience Required: 6 Years Minimum 4 years of specific experience in modelling, analysis and design of superstructure and substructure of RCC and PSC long span bridges. Experience with STAAD, MIDAS and/or Sofistik is required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for RITES Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online for RITES Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026 through the Career Section of the official RITES website. Visit the official RITES website. Open the Career section. Select the Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026 notification. Read the complete notification carefully. Check eligibility requirements for the desired consultant post. Complete the online application form. Enter personal details, educational qualifications and experience details. Upload required documents and certificates. Submit the application before the last date. Save the submitted application form for future reference. The online application facility is available through the RITES Career portal.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for RITES Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready while applying: Educational qualification certificates Engineering degree certificate and mark sheets Experience certificates Proof of date of birth Identity proof Recent photograph Updated CV / Resume Other documents supporting eligibility criteria Candidates shortlisted for the interview will be required to produce original documents for verification.

content_sections.heading: RITES Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates should ensure that they meet all eligibility requirements before applying. The engagement is purely on a consultant basis as per RITES terms and conditions. Applications will be scrutinised based on qualification and relevant experience. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Candidates should provide correct information in the application form. Providing false information may lead to rejection of candidature. The decision of RITES regarding eligibility and selection will be final. Candidates should regularly check the official RITES website for recruitment updates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: RITES has announced a total of 3 Individual Consultant vacancies for Sr. Design Review Engineer, Sr. Bridge Design Specialist and Sr. Bridge Design Engineer posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification required for RITES Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a B.E./B.Tech degree in Civil Engineering along with the required bridge design experience mentioned for each post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 30 August 2026 up to 23:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of RITES Individual Consultants?
faq.answer: The monthly payment ranges from ₹2,00,000 to ₹2,25,000 depending on the consultant position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for RITES Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes document scrutiny/verification followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. There is no application fee for candidates applying for RITES Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the job location for RITES Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The mentioned work location for these consultant positions is Kolkata, West Bengal.
